primary_findings.title: Mid-flight matrix rebind defeats APPROVAL_SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN (CWE-863)
primary_findings.why_it_matters: A project lead can approve their own record after submission. The self-review prohibition is checked only once, at submit-approval (records_actions.py:406), against the matrix bound at that moment. But when an intermediate step is approved, the pending role is re-derived from the LIVE project matrix (`_next_approval_role` resolves `resolve_project_matrix` fresh, records_actions.py:348-356), and `bind_to_project` allows rebinding a project's RECORD matrix at any time with no guard for in-flight IN_APPROVAL records (signature_matrices.py:300 just overwrites matrix_id). Attack: lead (global DESIGNER, PROJECT_LEAD in project) submits a record while the matrix is CHECKER→REVIEWER→APPROVER (self-check passes, DESIGNER not in chain), rebinds to e.g. [CHECKER, DESIGNER], and after the CHECKER passes step 1 the pending role for step 2 becomes DESIGNER — the submitter then signs their own record's remaining steps (the step gate at records_actions.py:479 only compares `record.approval_role != actor.role`). Deliverable signing already fixed this class of bug by snapshotting steps on the version at issue time (`_steps_for_version`, deliverable_service.py:1127); the record-side chain has no equivalent snapshot.

primary_findings.title: First-project race: default-matrix insert 500s without fallback
primary_findings.why_it_matters: The solutions corpus (docs/solutions/database-issues/dialect-options-invisible-on-sqlite.md, symptom 2) already documents this exact failure shape: a lock-free check-then-insert lets concurrent requests both pass the SELECT and collide on INSERT. On the first two concurrent POST /projects after a fresh install (or after the default template is renamed/disabled), both transactions run _get_or_create_default_record_matrix, both see no ACTIVE DEFAULT_RECORD_3_LEVEL, both INSERT, and the loser hits uq_signature_matrices_name_status (p9_010) with an unhandled IntegrityError -> 500 and the whole project creation rolls back. The in-file precedents (bind_to_project's savepoint+reread, _ensure_binding's collision reread) handle the identical race; this method skips it. || Adversarial-lens addendum: On a database where `DEFAULT_RECORD_3_LEVEL` does not exist yet (fresh install; p9_013 only backfills already-migrated DBs), two concurrent `POST /projects` both run `_get_or_create_default_record_matrix`, both SELECT-see nothing (READ COMMITTED), both INSERT — and the loser hits the (matrix_name, status) unique constraint that migration p9_010 added specifically because of this race. Unlike its sibling `_ensure_binding` (line 514) which catches IntegrityError, re-reads and returns the winner's row, this method has no handler: the second admin's request dies with a 500 and the whole project creation rolls back. The asymmetric fallback already exists in the same file and was deliberately built for the identical race shape.

primary_findings.title: Pagination silently applies the un-applied audit filter
primary_findings.why_it_matters: The page's own invariant (comment at lines 73-75 and the pending-hint at line 480) is that the table and CSV export use the filter frozen at the last 查询 click, not the live inputs. But `loadAuditLogs` runs from the pagination effect too (deps at line 248 omit `auditFilter`, yet the closure reads it), and its first statement re-freezes `appliedFilter = auditFilter`. Sequence: user changes the action filter without clicking 查询 (hint shows), then clicks page 2 — page 2 is fetched with the NEW filter while page 1 showed the OLD one, the hint vanishes as if 查询 had been clicked, and a subsequent CSV export uses a filter the user never applied. The table then mixes two different result sets under one total. || Maintainability-lens addendum: Editing filter inputs and then paging silently applies the un-submitted filter to the table and to the export baseline — contradicting the state's own comment (「已应用的筛选条件（点『查询』时冻结）—— 导出必须用它 … 否则 CSV 与屏幕上看到的行对不上」) and dismissing the 「改过但还没点查询」 warning. `setAppliedFilter(auditFilter)` sits inside `loadAuditLogs`, which the page effect also invokes on every page/pageSize change, so the freeze happens on pagination too, not just on 查询. A maintainer reasoning from the comment will mis-predict export behavior; a user can export under conditions they believed were not yet applied.

primary_findings.title: Sign dialog keeps stale proxy credentials
primary_findings.why_it_matters: Reopening the proxy (代录) dialog pre-fills the previous submission's AD username/password and the previous issue description/purpose. The dialog's own discipline comment says every open resets prior state ('每次打开都重置（否则上一次的理由/错误留在下一次里）'), but the open-effect only resets error/submitting/showReason/reason/reasonRequired — `proxyForm` (including `secondary_password`) and the issue fields are never touched, and antd's `destroyOnHidden` only unmounts modal children, not this state which lives in the always-mounted dialog component. An operator proxying approvals for several deliverables in a row can silently submit with the previous entry's secondary credentials (Input.Password shows only dots, so staleness is not obvious), and a new issue can carry the previous version's description. Resetting `proxyForm` (to the initial literal), `purpose`, and `description` in the same open-effect restores the stated reset discipline.

demoted_findings.title: errorText copy-pasted in two components; central formatter added same batch
demoted_findings.why_it_matters: Users of the signing UI get inconsistent error copy depending on which surface renders it. This same batch added `describePcsError`/`isPermissionError` to src/api/errors.ts as the unified envelope formatter (used by UserAdminPage, ProjectAdminPage, AuditLogPage), yet DeliverableSignDialog and DeliverableProgressPage each define their own local `errorText` with a near-identical body — one formats with a halfwidth colon (`${data.code}: ${data.message}`), the other fullwidth (`${data.code}：${data.message}`), and neither gets the 403 「无权查看：」 prefix that describePcsError applies. DeliverableProgressPage even renders its copy for the list-level 403 error, so a permission failure on the progress page shows a raw code while the same failure on the audit page shows 「无权查看：…」. Three formatters now must be updated in step when the error envelope changes. Moving one helper into api/errors.ts (or calling describePcsError from both) restores a single formatting path. Follow-up: after centralizing, the shared formatter needs direct unit tests for the 403-prefixed and non-403 paths (maintainability testing gap folded here).

demoted_findings.title: New `as never` casts defeat generated-type checking
demoted_findings.why_it_matters: `as never` is the strongest possible silencer — `never` is assignable to every type, so the compiler stops checking the prop entirely. This batch adds two new ones: `workflowType={section.workflow_type as never}` (DeliverableProgressPage:646) and `<StateBadge status={(signStatus ?? 'DRAFT') as never} />` (RecordDetailDrawer:54). For 646, `WorkflowProgressSection.workflow_type` is `string` in the generated contract; if the aggregate endpoint later emits a workflow type the panel doesn't know, the cast hides the mismatch that the batch's own discipline (types come from generated api.d.ts) was supposed to surface at compile time. A maintainer changing WorkflowProgressPanel's prop type gets no error at this call site. Widening the shared prop types deletes the casts instead of accumulating them.

demoted_findings.title: resetMockSignState resets only sign state, not comments/admin seed
demoted_findings.why_it_matters: resetMockSignState() is the test-isolation seam for anything mounting signFlowHandlers, but it only restores mockSignSteps and mockDeliverableSignStatus. The disable handler mutates the shared exported seedAdminUsers objects in place (user.status = 'DISABLED'; user.token_version += 1) and the comments handler pushes into a module-level array that nothing resets. Vitest isolates per file, so today no test breaks — but the next test added to tests/mocks/signFlow.test.ts (or a new file reusing these handlers) that exercises admin disable or comment POST inherits earlier tests' mutations: generated comment_id (`c-${comments.length + 1}`) and user status/token_version become order-dependent, producing exactly the flaky by-order green/red this reset function was created to prevent.
demoted_findings.suggested_fix: Extend resetMockSignState() in src/mocks/signFlow.ts to also restore the other mutable state: rebuild comments from seedRecordComments.items (comments.length = 0; comments.push(...seedRecordComments.items)) and restore each seedAdminUsers entry's status/token_version (or snapshot originals at module load and re-apply; alternatively have the disable handler operate on a per-request copy). Rename not needed.

triage_groups.title: Record approval chain is resolved from the live matrix, not frozen at submit
triage_groups.context: The pending approval role is re-derived from the current project binding at every intermediate step (records_actions.py:512), so a mid-approval rebind changes who may sign after the one-time self-review check at submit has already passed; the same resolver's new non-ACTIVE 409 branch ships untested.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Decide the freeze mechanism first (#1: chain snapshot at submit, mirroring deliverable_service.py:1105-1130, or a per-step submitter-identity re-assert), then write #9's 409 test against the settled shape.
triage_groups.why: APPROVAL_SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN is enforced exactly once, at submit; everything after trusts mutable configuration.

triage_groups.title: POST /projects create-path guards
triage_groups.context: The new create endpoint checks existence but not workspace type, uniqueness, or concurrent first-use of the default matrix.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Settle the FORMAL-only policy in #4 (backend 422 WORKSPACE_NOT_FORMAL + listWorkspaces filter), then apply #5 (IntegrityError -> 409 mapping at the flush) and #6 (savepoint + reread around the default-matrix INSERT, mirroring bind_to_project/_ensure_binding) mechanically.
triage_groups.why: All three sit in the same 30-line create path; one review of the transaction covers all fixes.

triage_groups.title: AuditLogPage pagination correctness
triage_groups.context: The applied-filter freeze happens inside loadAuditLogs, so pagination queries with un-applied edits, and this batch's new audit_id tiebreaker has no disjoint-pages test.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Fix #10 first (only the 查询 handler sets appliedFilter; loadAuditLogs queries with the applied value), then add #8's ordering test, which also pins #10's behavior.
triage_groups.why: Both concern the same list-loading path; the test written second should assert both the freeze and the stable ordering.
